Jorge (SuccessOps): Can we triage infra traces quickly? Pinging eng-runtime to get a perf baseline and error rates.
Sophia (Enablement): I can run a 30-min targeted enablement + live debug session. Short checklist + follow-up playbook. When do you want it?

Subject: Quick sync to remove blockers for Coastline
Hi Alex — we noticed you hit latency during the sample run and wanted to get you unblocked quickly. Can we do a 30-min session to debug and walk through a short checklist? We can also enable a free 2-week dedicated trial if helpful.
Thanks,
Maya
